oracle: C22: a reader of the draft keeps its place when a peer save reloads its frame (suspect S28)
what: useDocFrame.reload no longer captures the frame's scroll before the reload, so every peer save puts the reader back at the top of the document

target.case: C22-serial positive control: the same held frame loads, reply box and typists, one save at a time: each typist saves once the reader's previous reload shows the last token, and the reader types a piece of its reply between saves; its place and its reply are kept [N=2]
